summary: Delta review found missing fix-scope acceptance and two remaining design-fix workflow defects.

findings.summary: Expanded S1 and S2 scope has no matching recorded acceptance.
findings.evidence: ENG-4 and Confirmed test scope require explicit acceptance of the exact current seam-to-failure-path scope. Plan lines 125-126 add the design-reservation writer/atomic clear and answer commit-failure retry; line 140 only says the orchestrator reports a fix-stage cruise override, without identifying a matching answer. factory/state.json decisions contain cruise-override answers only at grill, plan Q1 and remediate Q1, not at fix, and no fix-stage relay record exists. The earlier remediate Q1 acceptance at line 138 predates and does not name these extensions.
findings.fix: Obtain and persist a protected acceptance or cruise-override answer for the complete current S1-S4 scope, including both extensions, and reference that answer and its scope snapshot in the plan.

findings.summary: First design fix can enter fix stage without persisting its reservation.
findings.evidence: FR-003 and plan design decision 2 require checkpoint review --next fix --design-fix to reserve the attempt before spawning. This new writer only creates the reservation when the stored stage is already review, but SKILL.md steps 6-7 do not checkpoint into review before the first verdict. This run demonstrates that flow: state at commit 3e81adc was at implement, and its first checkpoint review --next fix moved it directly to fix. Under the same flow with --design-fix, line 930 skips the reservation while line 983 still advances the stage, so resume cannot use its saved design verdict or preserve the required reservation. The added test starts only at stage review.
findings.fix: Ensure the first review is durably entered before this command or create the reservation on the legitimate first transition from implement/verify, while preserving retry idempotence; cover the documented first-review flow through the CLI.

findings.summary: Design fix sequence still does not record the fresh verification result required by the review gate.
findings.evidence: The round-1 SPEC-6 verdict requires fixer completion, verification, then checkpoint fix --next review so the gate sees the post-fix result. The changed design sequence says only 'verify (SKILL.md step 6)', but SKILL.md:135 only runs build and tests and never calls factory verify; references/state.md:215 identifies verify --pass|--fail as the writer of the history record read by the review gate. checks.py:304-319 reads that latest record. After a recorded verify-fail, a successful rerun following these instructions still leaves the failure as latest and checkpoint refuses; with an earlier pass it can instead accept stale evidence.
findings.fix: Explicitly record the actual post-fix result with factory verify --pass or --fail before checkpointing, including on resume, and require a fresh passing record before re-review.
